findings.reason: Confirmed. In AUDIT-15, OverconvergentAutomorphicForms:O0 targets[4] categorically denies smooth p-adic-group representation theory and MetaplecticAutomorphicForms:MP.3 targets[3] restricts the existing theory to finite/Lie/algebraic groups; MP.3 targets[2] already cites the counterexample. Read TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Homological/ContCohomology/SmoothDiscrete.lean at f790474: namespace TauCeti at 202; ofDiscreteModule at 226 with its scalar-action assumptions at 212-214; IsSmoothDiscrete at 254-258 for arbitrary topological monoids; continuous-homomorphism restriction at 268-276; the constructor's smoothness theorem at 301-313; the topological-group equivalence with ContinuousSMul at 324-328; and equivariant linear maps at 376-380. There is no finite/compact restriction on G. Credit this reusable smooth-discrete TopRep foundation with related citations and correct both notes. Preserve the assumptions: discreteness plus open stabilizers, compatible continuous scalar action, and continuity in the group variable for the smooth constructor; ofDiscreteModule alone does not make an arbitrary action smooth. This is not a theorem about arbitrary Banach or locally analytic coefficients with their usual topology, and does not supply admissibility, finite length, Jacquet functors, theta modules or the locally analytic family targets. Leave the complete targets absent and layer verdicts unchanged. Both inaccurate notes still occur in generated library coverage.

Confirmed. OverconvergentAutomorphicForms:O0 targets[2] says neither library contains locally analytic function or distribution theory on the strength of a literal phrase search. At Mathlib 082e2d3, Analysis/Analytic/Basic.lean:58-59 assumes a NontriviallyNormedField and normed spaces, not an archimedean field; HasFPowerSeriesOnBall:74-79 requires positive radius bounded by the series radius and actual HasSum convergence. HasFPowerSeriesAt:95-96, AnalyticAt:110-111 and AnalyticOnNhd:120-121 are genuine local analytic function notions. Read also ContinuousLinearMap.analyticAt in Analysis/Analytic/Linear.lean:61-62 under 23-25, AnalyticAt.comp in Composition.lean:859-862 under 292-294, and the NontriviallyNormedField instance for Q_p in NumberTheory/Padics/PadicNumbers.lean:872-877 under [Fact p.Prime] at 831. These refute the blanket function-theory absence, but not the separate lack of the specific distribution/affinoid-family constructions. Add related foundation citations and narrow the note to the missing uniform radius for the bounded Hilbert weight family, the requisite distribution spaces and rigid/affinoid comparison. AnalyticAt alone provides no uniform estimate over an affinoid weight parameter. Retain absent for the full target and not built for O0. The original overbroad note is still exported to library coverage.

R18.5 (:168-176) constructs Drinfeld half-plane/formal and Cerednik-Drinfeld Shimura-curve uniformization plus graph/monodromy comparison; R11.3 (:44-50) supplies Raynaud uniformization of degenerating abelian varieties. The audit notes themselves call these imports, consumed local classification, general theory behind character groups, and exported local moduli. Under REV-AUDIT-15's stated exclusion of inputs/consumers these are not duplicate constructions. Remove only R18.2/C6, R18.3/R16.2, R18.5/R11.3 and R18.6/R23.2 from duplicates. Preserve the actual dependencies, comparisons and exports; retain R18.3/R17.3 and H6/R23.2, which concern genuinely shared targets, and leave all unrelated entries alone. No layer verdict change follows. All four disputed entries still occur in generated coverage; amend the audit source and let normal integration regenerate it.

Confirmed for exactly six named records. Read MetaplecticAutomorphicForms scope and MP.0-MP.6, AutomorphicLFunctionsAndLocalFactors AL.0, AdelicAlgebraicGroups AA.1, all QuadraticFormInvariants 6C, and GrossZagierAndArithmeticHeights GZ.6. MP.0 builds the Heisenberg group/Schrodinger model on AL.0's Schwartz-Bruhat spaces; it does not reconstruct those spaces. MP.2 defines and computes the Weil index and Weil representation using 6C's Hilbert symbol; 6C constructs the symbol/local Hasse invariant, not the Weil index or representation. MP.4 constructs a central cover, rational splitting and Weil action on AL.0's restricted tensor product: AA.1's ordinary adelic algebraic-group points and AL.0's function space are inputs, not those constructions. MP.5 derives its theta transformation and analytic/genuine automorphic theory using AL.0's Poisson summation; that proof input is not another theta kernel. MP.6 explicitly exports local sections/conventions to GZ.6, which constructs arithmetic cycles, global incoherent kernels/derivatives and the projected arithmetic comparison; MP.6 expressly reserves that derivative identity to GZ.6. Remove only MP.0/AL.0, MP.2/QFI-6C, MP.4/AA.1, MP.4/AL.0, MP.5/AL.0 and MP.6/GZ.6 from duplicates. Keep supplier APIs, cover-specific work and downstream arithmetic work; do not broaden this to remove the other overlap records. All six survive in generated coverage and should be corrected through the accepted audit source. No library-presence or layer-verdict upgrade follows.

Confirmed for all eight specified entries, after reading O2-O8 and the complete named T4/T5/S5/S6/H4/C6 contracts plus the audit target/duplicate records. T4's geometric period-map bounds are used with O0's weight radius to prove O2's analytic automorphy factor. T5's modified differential lattice/torsor supplies O3's integral coefficient sheaf and section spaces; it is not that sheaf construction. S5 compares geometric/arithmetic towers and polarization torsors; O4 performs coefficient-sensitive sheaf descent and compares four presentations. H4 computes ineffective groups and finite versus profinite polarization groups used by O4, rather than constructing its sheaves. T5's AIP torsor comparison is expressly the input to O5's independent coefficient-sheaf construction and sheaf isomorphism. C6 supplies Koecher extension; O6 consumes it while constructing boundary-vanishing cusp forms and Hecke/compactness results. T5 constructs the Igusa tower; O7 constructs completed functions/sections and their ordered limits and ordinary restriction. S6 constructs the general toroidal-diamond period map/Levi-torsor pullback; O8 applies this geometric input to datum-specific coefficient sheaves. Remove only O2/T4, O3/T5, O4/S5, O4/H4, O5/T5, O6/C6, O7/T5 and O8/S6 from duplicates. Preserve every named import, comparison, radius/group hypothesis and remaining overlap. In particular, neither a torsor comparison alone nor Koecher extension alone supplies the consumer's sheaf theorem or cusp condition. All eight records still appear in generated coverage; correct the audit source and regenerate through normal integration. No change to library status or layer verdict follows.
